contentText:
Ella Langley’s “Choosin Texas” continues its run on the top, Stella Lefty’s “Boston” holds its No. 2 spot and Taylor Swift, Olivia Dean, Ariana Grande and Morgan Wallen fill out the rest of the top 10.

This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Sept. 5. Locked at No. 10 is “Be Her.” As is “Man I Need” at No. 9. Ella and Morgan fall to 8 while “So Easy” stays at 7. “Dracula” is up to No. 6. Ariana Grande hangs out at 5. “Been By Now” is still at 4. So is Taylor Swift at 3 and “Boston” at No. 2. So grabbing a 20th week at No. 1 is “Choosin’ Texas.”
